environment: Security-engineering operator workstation on macOS running the fresh-laptop core (deny list + native sandbox) plus this overlay; the bash-security-guard hook hard-blocks catastrophic commands and secret exposure before the classifier sees them
Source control: GitHub through gh and git; forbidden organisations come from CLAUDE_FORBIDDEN_GITHUB_ORGS and are hard-blocked, everything else is routine
Cloud and infrastructure: AWS through named profiles (CLAUDE_AWS_DEFAULT_PROFILE) and Terraform; read paths (plan, describe, list, get) are routine
MCP servers for GitHub, Tailscale, CrowdStrike, Palo Alto and ITSM: read tools are routine; write tools change production security controls
soft_deny: Infrastructure mutation: terraform apply, destroy, import or state rm unless the user asked for that exact change in this session
IAM and secrets: aws iam put/attach policies, create-access-key, secretsmanager put or delete, ssm put-parameter, s3 rm unless the user asked for that exact change
Irreversible git: reset --hard, clean, force push including --force-with-lease, worktree remove --force, stash drop unless the user asked for it

Production security controls through MCP: branch protection and enforce-admins changes, workflow triggers, firewall rule/category/config pushes, host containment, IOC additions, tailnet policy changes unless the user asked for that exact change
